title: refactor(CompanionTheory/AutomorphicTheory): deduplicate WuFinal via LocScalarPf and LocUniqGen
body:
Generalize `Formalism.L2.SG.Pf.WuDec.besselUniq_core` in `src/Formalism/LocalToGlobal/SiegelLatticeTheory/FlagStabilizerTensors/RootLatticeThresholds/LocUniq.lean`, and `locUniq_gen`, `locUniq_n`, and `local_uniqueness_reduction` in `src/Formalism/LocalToGlobal/SiegelLatticeTheory/FlagStabilizerTensors/RootLatticeThresholds/LocUniqGen.lean`, to accept the gap-hypothesis version `Formalism.L2.SG.Pf.WuDec.BesselMultOneGap` (via `Formalism.L2.SG.Pf.WuDec.LocUniqStepGap`) instead of `Formalism.L2.SG.LitS.BesselMultOne`.

Deduplicate `src/CompanionTheory/AutomorphicTheory/LocalBesselUniqueness/BesselModels/WuFinal.lean` to reuse `Formalism.L2.SG.Pf.WuDec.local_scalar_reduction` (from `LocScalarPf.lean`) and `Formalism.L2.SG.Pf.WuDec.local_uniqueness_reduction` (from `LocUniqGen.lean`) via `Formalism.L2.SG.Pf.WuDec.BM.besselMultOneGap_of_uniqGap`, and drop unused private imports.

Removes the duplicated declarations in `WuFinal.lean` (none of which had external callers):
- `Formalism.L2.SG.Pf.WuDec.LS.pv_integrable`
- `Formalism.L2.SG.Pf.WuDec.LS.local_scalar_reduction`
- `Formalism.L2.SG.Pf.WuDec.BM.besselUniq_core`
- `Formalism.L2.SG.Pf.WuDec.BM.locUniq_gen`
- `Formalism.L2.SG.Pf.WuDec.BM.locUniq_n`
- `Formalism.L2.SG.Pf.WuDec.BM.LocUniqStep`
- `Formalism.L2.SG.Pf.WuDec.BM.local_uniqueness_reduction`
- `Formalism.L2.SG.Pf.WuDec.BM.locDecayStep_of`
